name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text:
**Decision: Focus first on cleaning up the "broken link" pile before adding new links.**

This is the fastest way to push coverage toward 100% because dead links are the biggest blocker right now. Every fixed link is a guaranteed +1% coverage with no extra work. The trade-off is that we’re delaying new content, but that’s worth it—broken links drag down the whole project, and fixing them is low-effort once we triage them. Once the pile is under control, we can ramp up fresh link hunting without the backlog slowing us down.

name: Scriv
text: While cleaning up broken links is indeed a quick way to boost coverage, we risk overlooking valuable new content that could also enhance our coverage significantly. By focusing solely on fixing existing issues, we may miss the opportunity to attract more users with fresh links. To settle this, we could consider a balanced approach: allocate a specific percentage of our efforts to adding new links while addressing broken ones, ensuring we’re not just fixing problems but actively enhancing our resource pool.
